New protocol for BDK-452; the alarm overlay's ring event and its dismiss/snooze return path

interface.name: deck_alarm_v1
interface.description: Lightweight compositor-relayed IPC for the alarm overlay to show firing alarm and allow to dismiss or snooze it.

request.name: snooze_alarm
request.description: Request the compositor to snooze the alarm.

request.name: dismiss_alarm
request.description: Request the compositor to dismiss the alarm.

description.summary: whether a firing alarm may be snoozed

entry.name: not_allowed
entry.summary: the alarm may not be snoozed

event.name: alarm_ringing
event.description: Sent when an alarm fires. Carries what the overlay renders: the alarm's scheduled time, its label, and whether snoozing is allowed. The overlay maps its full-screen surface on this event and unmaps after the user dismisses or snoozes.

arg.name: snooze_allowed
arg.summary: whether the alarm may be snoozed

event.name: alarm_stopped
event.description: Sent when the alarm is no longer ringing for a reason this overlay did not initiate (timeout, dismissal from another surface, or bmc fallback). The overlay unmaps its surface.
